program.name: freeway-static-entry-rule-v1
program.guidance: Apply this simple conditional rule to the current boxes. Let p=player[1]. For each car let x=bbox[0], y=bbox[1]. Choose NOOP if there is a car with 34 < x < 52 AND 10 <= p-y < 26. All four inequalities must hold for the SAME car. If no car satisfies all of them, choose UP. Never choose DOWN. This is a deliberately reactive policy: use current positions only; do not predict motion or replace this rule with a general scoring strategy. The y condition selects a lane just ahead; the x condition selects a car near our crossing column. Check every lane, ignoring cars that fail either condition.

action_criteria.NOOP: At least one car simultaneously has x>34, x<52, player_y-car_y>=10, and player_y-car_y<26.
action_criteria.UP: Every car fails at least one of the four NOOP conditions.
